$comment: Invented review and reply templates. scripts/generate.mjs uses them only when it re-rates a review in a non-scenario account to match source/distributions.json. Slots: {brand} brand name, {place} 'the <shortName> location' for multi-location accounts or the brand name for single-location ones, {staff} one named staff member, {service} one of the account's services, {first} the reviewer's first name, {signoff} the account's reply sign-off. Never put real businesses, people, or places here.

dental-healthcare.text: Easy visit for {service}. {staff} was gentle and quick, and I was back at work before lunch.
{staff} made {service} painless. Clear pricing up front from {brand}, no surprises at checkout.

I put off {service} for years because I was nervous. {staff} at {place} walked me through every step, kept checking that I was comfortable, and the whole thing took less time than I expected. I already booked my next visit.
Front desk at {place} squeezed me in the same week for {service}. {staff} explained what my insurance would cover before we started.
Our whole family goes to {brand} now. {staff} is patient with the kids and honest with the adults.
Moved to the area and needed a new dentist fast. {brand} had me in for {service} within days, the office was spotless, and {staff} sent a follow-up text the next morning to check how I was feeling.
Quick, friendly, and on time for {service}. Done right the first visit.
Good care from {staff} on {service}. The wait at {place} ran about fifteen minutes long.
{brand} did a careful job on {service} and the billing was straightforward. Parking is tight, so plan a few extra minutes, but I'd come back without hesitation.
Friendly team and solid work. Online booking at {place} was a little clunky.

home-services.text: {brand} sent {staff} out the next morning for {service}. Fair quote, tidy work, and the shoe covers stayed on the whole time.
{staff} explained two options for {service} and recommended the cheaper one. Done in an afternoon.

We had a tight timeline before guests arrived, and {brand} still fit {service} in that week. {staff} texted twenty minutes out, walked us through the work at the end, and left the place cleaner than it was.
Called {brand} about {service} and got a real person right away. Showed up in the window they promised.
Third job with {brand} and they're consistent every time. {staff} knows our house by now.
Great experience with {service}. On time, fair, and friendly.

Honest crew. We called about {service}, and {staff} found the real problem in ten minutes without upselling us on anything we didn't need. The invoice matched the estimate to the dollar, which is rare.
Good work on {service}. Scheduling took a few days longer than I hoped, but {staff} was great once here.
{brand} handled {service} well and cleaned up after. The price was a bit higher than one other quote, but they could start sooner and the warranty is better, so it was worth it to us.
Solid job by {staff}. Wish the arrival window had been shorter.

legal.text: {staff} handled {service} for me with patience and clear explanations. I always knew what came next.
Responsive and practical. {brand} gave me a flat fee for {service} and stuck to it.

I came to {brand} stressed and confused about {service}. {staff} took the time to explain my options in plain language, answered every email within a day, and got it resolved sooner than I thought possible.
Second time working with {staff} at {place}. Same careful, steady approach on {service}.
Clear advice, fair billing, quick replies. Would hire {brand} again.
{staff} prepared me well for every step of {service}. The paperwork was organized and nothing was missed.

I interviewed three firms before choosing {brand} for {service}. They were the only ones who gave me a realistic picture instead of a sales pitch, and {staff} kept me updated at every milestone without my having to chase anyone.
Good outcome on {service}. A couple of calls took a day or two to return, but {staff} was thorough.
{brand} did careful work on {service}. The initial consult at {place} started late, though the rest of the process ran on schedule and the advice was sound.
Knowledgeable team. Billing statements could be easier to read.

agency.text: {brand} handled {service} for us and the results were obvious within a month. {staff} keeps the updates short and useful.
Clear reporting, quick turnaround, and no jargon. {staff} has been a great point of contact for {service}.

We switched to {brand} after a frustrating year with another partner. {staff} audited where we stood, set realistic goals for {service}, and delivered on every one of them. Our team finally knows what is working and why.
{staff} answered every question about {service} the same day. Easy partner to work with.
Great partner for {service}. Responsive and organized.
{brand} took {service} off our plate completely. Monthly check-ins with {staff} are the most useful meeting on our calendar.

Onboarding with {brand} was smooth and fast. {staff} learned our locations by name in the first week, flagged two quick wins for {service}, and the dashboard they set up is something our regional managers actually open.
Good results on {service}. Kickoff took a little longer than planned, but {staff} kept things moving after that.
{brand} is reliable and the reporting is clear. A few requests on {service} took longer than we'd like during busy weeks, but the quality was always there.
Solid partner. Pricing for add-ons could be clearer.

automotive.text: {staff} had {service} done by the time promised and texted photos before doing anything extra.
Fair price on {service} and a clean waiting area. {brand} is my shop now.

Dropped the car at {place} for {service} on my way to work. {staff} called with a clear quote mid-morning, explained what could wait until next time, and it was ready before five. No pressure, no surprises.
Quick and honest. {staff} checked one extra thing for free and didn't charge me for it.
Booked {service} online and was in and out in under an hour. Great service.
Been to a lot of shops and {brand} is the first one where I trust the quote. {staff} showed me the worn part, explained the options for {service}, and the final bill came in under the estimate.
{brand} got my car in the same day for {service}. Friendly team.
Good work on {service}. It ran about an hour longer than quoted, but {staff} kept me posted.
{brand} did a solid job on {service} at a fair price. The waiting area at {place} was crowded on a Saturday morning, so I'd book a weekday next time.
Reliable shop. Phone hold times can be long.

casual: Thanks so much, {first}! Happy we could help, and we'll pass this along to the team.
{first}, this made our day. Thanks for trusting us, and see you next time!
Thank you, {first}! We love hearing this and will share it with the crew.
neutral: Thank you for the kind words, {first}. We're glad everything went smoothly and look forward to seeing you again.
We appreciate you taking the time to share this, {first}. It means a lot to our team.
Thanks, {first}. We're glad we could help and have shared your note with the team.
formal: Thank you for your review, {first}. We appreciate your trust and are pleased the matter was handled to your satisfaction.
We are grateful for your feedback, {first}, and glad our team could assist you.
Thank you, {first}. It was a privilege to work with you, and we appreciate you sharing your experience.

casual: Thanks for the honest feedback, {first}. We're working on that and hope to make your next visit even better.
neutral: Thank you for the feedback, {first}. We've shared your note with the team so we can improve.
formal: Thank you for your candid feedback, {first}. We have shared it with our team and will use it to improve.

casual: {first}, we're sorry this wasn't the experience you deserved. Please reach out so we can make it right.
neutral: We're sorry to hear this, {first}. Please contact our office directly so we can look into it and make things right.
formal: We regret that your experience fell short, {first}. Please contact our office directly so we may address your concerns.
